text_block_list.text:
Just before the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
Matikanefukukitaru received an unexpected 
visitor.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... is Fukukitaru here?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san!? Wait, is that you, 
Suzuka-san!? What's the matter!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Feels like it's been ages, but also kinda 
not!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Which is it...? Excuse me, got a second? 
Fukukitaru's Trainer too, if you don't 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, it's fully autumn outside, isn't 
it? Roasted sweet potatoes and roasted 
chestnuts are so delicious, it's such a 
happy season~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Happiness... Hey, Fukukitaru, are you 
happy right now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Suzuka-san? What's the matter all of 
a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering how she's been 
lately. For a while, she seemed really 
lost.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I'm really sorry about what happened 
back during the Kinko Sho! Please let me 
apologize once again...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lately... let's see. If I had to say... 
I'd say I'm happy, probably!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm surrounded by so many 
precious people. Like Trainer, and all my 
fans!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Racing all-out and sharing the highs and 
lows with all those people... it's just 
so, so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! I also know how you can 
achieve the greatest, ultimate, 
mega-blessing level of happiness from here 
on out.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's that...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That would be—living a long life!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if you want to spend lots of time 
with the people you cherish, you gotta 
live a long life, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Better 100 than 50! And better 200 than 
100! The longer you live, the more time 
multiplies. Long live longevity!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Live a long life... Yes. If Fukukitaru has 
found her own happiness, then that's 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How are things for you now, Suzuka-san? 
Are you happy?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... About average, I'd say. I do feel 
some response, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Because I haven't reached it yet. —What 
lies beyond the speed."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's what you mentioned earlier, right? Do 
you think you can pull it off?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe, just a little further. I feel like 
my happiness is waiting just beyond that."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It might only be for a brief moment. But 
I'll seize happiness too, and I won't lose 
to Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh no. I need to finish up the entry 
procedures soon. See you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes, see you later! Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Pardon?
choice_data_list: Good luck. Don't push yourself too hard.
Good luck. Don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm fine. I'm feeling very good 
right now. Thank you for your concern.

"Even among Umamusume, happiness takes 
many shapes. The path ahead is clear for 
both of them."

Matikanefukukitaru kept waving her hand 
forever at Silence Suzuka's departing 
silhouette.
